pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using NaOH solutions of 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8% w/v concentrations applied to dewatered waste activated sludge (DWAS)
Photocatalytic pretreatment using TiO2 nanoparticles (0.3, 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6 g/L) applied to dewatered waste activated sludge (DWAS)
Alkaline-photocatalytic pretreatment combining NaOH pretreatment with TiO2 NPs pretreatment, where each NaOH dose was combined with all TiO2 NPs doses
